requirementReferences.title: Field Separator follows Segment Type and Segment Length
Dual-delimiter scheme for Adjusted Product Code Data Segment
requirementReferences.scopeNote: This draft exercises only the Field Separator after Segment Type and Segment Length, not the Product Data Field Delimiter or Adjusted Product Amount clauses.

sourceEvidence.quote: Notes: A Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length. A Field Separator follows Product Amount when Product Amount is the very last element in the segment. When a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: For the Segment 102 table, a Field Separator follows both header fields; the field separator after Product Amount depends on whether it is the final element.

sourceEvidence.quote: Notes: A Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length. A Field Separator follows Adjusted Product Amount when Adjusted Product Amount is the very last element in the segment. When a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: For the Segment 157 table, a Field Separator follows both header fields; the trailing separator after Adjusted Product Amount depends on whether it is the final element.
